title: iria consanguinea
intro: Iria consanguinea, commonly known as Iria, is a plant species found in the tropical regions of Central and South America. It is a shrub that grows up to 3 meters in height and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiparasitic properties. The health benefits of Iria include its ability to treat fever, digestive issues, and skin conditions, while its therapeutic actions include pain relief, wound healing, and anti-arthritic effects. The bioactive constituents of Iria include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
